summary: Move interval boundaries under a normal curve while separating density height from probability area.
objective: Create a Gaussian density ribbon with draggable interval endpoints and linked x and z-score axes.
intent_signals: Create a Gaussian density ribbon with draggable interval endpoints and linked x and z-score axes.
Move interval boundaries under a normal curve while separating density height from probability area.
example_prompts: Create a Gaussian density ribbon with draggable interval endpoints and linked x and z-score axes.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of normal distribution area with standardization axes.
negative_signals: No confidence interval or hypothesis test is implied by selecting a probability interval.
not_for: No confidence interval or hypothesis test is implied by selecting a probability interval.

entities.name: Density ribbon
entities.guidance: Sample the curve in an x-density plane and extrude only a thin constant decorative depth; show visible plotting limits and omitted tails.

entities.name: Interval curtain
entities.guidance: Shade the area between curve and baseline over [a,b]; display handles projected to the x axis, not freely floating in 3D.

entities.name: Standardization axes
entities.guidance: Align z=(x-mu)/sigma with x positions and show density units reciprocal to x units.

state_contract.model: Finite mean mu, sigma>0; density exp(-0.5*((x-mu)/sigma)^2)/(sigma*sqrt(2*pi)). Probability in [a,b] comes from the normal CDF difference, a<=b.
state_contract.authority: Distribution parameters and interval endpoints own numeric area and sampled curve; extrusion depth is decorative and never contributes to probability.
actions: Move mean or positive standard deviation.
Switch between raw and standardized coordinates.

invariants: A zero-width interval has zero probability although point density may be positive.
At fixed z bounds, changing mu or sigma leaves interval probability unchanged.
motion_guidance: Recompute the analytic CDF area during changes; do not estimate probability from rendered pixel coverage.
If the x viewport clips tails, retain full-distribution normalization rather than renormalizing the visible curve.
known_limits: No confidence interval or hypothesis test is implied by selecting a probability interval.
A truncated viewport is not a truncated normal distribution; tails and density scaling are labeled.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: A normal variable with mean mu and positive standard deviation sigma is standardized by z=(x-mu)/sigma.
claims.scope: Declared normal model; probability areas refer to continuous intervals, not point probabilities.

object_craft.structure: Sample the curve in an x-density plane and extrude only a thin constant decorative depth; show visible plotting limits and omitted tails.
object_craft.material: Flat shaded area against a pale baseline; avoid reflective extrusion that makes height appear to encode volume probability.
